//: Marketplace catalog. Copy to plugin-registry.json (gitignored) or point GROKBOT2_PLUGIN_REGISTRY at a file or URL. Credentials are ${PLACEHOLDERS} resolved at spawn from the backend environment or .data/secrets/<user>.json — never write a real token here, this file is meant to be shared.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Knowledge graph the agent writes to and recalls from across sessions. No credentials.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Repos, issues, pull requests and code search. Needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: lark
plugins.description: Messages, docs, sheets, calendar and Base through the Lark OpenAPI. Needs LARK_APP_ID and LARK_APP_SECRET from your Lark developer console.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Read, search, draft and send mail. One-time browser sign-in first: npx @gongrzhe/server-gmail-autoauth-mcp auth (needs a Google OAuth client file).

plugins.name: facebook
plugins.description: Post to a Page, read comments and insights. Community package, not audited by us. Needs FACEBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN and FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID.

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Search, read and write pages and databases. Needs NOTION_TOKEN from a Notion integration, shared with the pages it may touch.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, read the accessibility tree. No credentials.

plugins.name: n8n
plugins.description: Build and run n8n workflows. Serves node documentation with no credentials; set N8N_API_URL and N8N_API_KEY to reach your own instance.

plugins.name: filesystem
plugins.description: Read and write files under one root you choose. Set GROKBOT2_FS_ROOT — deliberately required, since it decides what the agent may touch.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Up-to-date API documentation and code examples for public libraries. No credentials.

plugins.name: sequential-thinking
plugins.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning scratchpad for long problems. No credentials.
